name: Neeka Bloodscar

narrative.details:
The Badlands is harsh and lies close to the Alliance-held land of Loch Modan, so communication between Stonard and the Badlands outpost of Kargath is often cut.

Prove yourself, adventurer.  Travel to the Badlands and speak with Neeka Bloodscar, head scout of the Kargath outpost.  Speak with her, and then send her report back to me.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Helgrum wants a report, eh? I sent an outrunner to Stonard not three days past. Did he fail his mission? If Stonard does not have my report, then it appears he did fail.

Let's hope the next runner I send has more skill, or more luck.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 35 to 40, 3,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Report to Helgrum
quests.objectiveText: Bring Neeka's Report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.
